content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "product": ["Tea", "Coffee", "Tea", "Juice"],
    "category": ["Drink", "Drink", "Drink", "Fruit"],
    "units": [2, 1, 3, 4],
    "price": [12.0, 45.0, 12.0, 25.0],
    "date": ["2026-01-01", "2026-01-02", "2026-01-03", "2026-01-04"],
    "customer": ["Mira", "Dev", "Mira", "Ari"],
})

indexed = df.set_index("product")
print(indexed.loc["Coffee", "units"])
print(indexed.reset_index().columns.tolist())
